concept.concept_description: For every semi-complete digraph G, the directed clique-width of G is at most the cycle rank of G plus 2.
concept.mathematical_framing: For every semi-complete digraph G, the directed clique-width of G is at most the cycle rank of G plus 2.
concept.lean_guess: Prove by induction on the cycle rank. Base cases: acyclic graphs (cr=0) have directed clique-width ≤ 2. For inductive step, use the cycle rank decomposition: when G is strongly connected, remove a vertex v to get G-v with cr(G-v) ≤ cr(G)-1. By inductive hypothesis, cw(G-v) ≤ cr(G-v)+2 ≤ cr(G)+1. Then show that adding v back and reconnecting edges in the semi-complete manner increases the directed clique-width by at most 1.
